in_sanskrit.name: Baiju
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Banyan Tree
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baiju एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Baiju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vat' which means 'banyan tree'. In Hindu mythology, the banyan tree is considered sacred and symbolizes strength, stability, and longevity. A banyan tree can live for thousands of years and its roots spread far and wide, nurturing countless other plants. The name Baiju is thus believed to bestow upon the bearer the qualities of strength, resilience, and nurturing abilities.
